newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somalia battle leaves three dead, seven wounded.
newsitem.headline: Somalia battle leaves three dead, seven wounded.

text.p: At least three people were killed and seven wounded in Somalia when militiamen loyal to rival faction leaders clashed in a southeast village, according to radio reports on Tuesday.

At Gobwein, 10 km (six miles) north of the southeast port of Kismayo, forces loyal to General Mohamed Siad "Hersi" Morgan on Monday fought Marehan clansmen who split with Morgan to side with faction leader Hussein Aideed, Somalia's self-proclaimed president.

Morgan's militia were preparing a counter-attack against the new Aideed alliance at Gobwein, leading to fears among the business and aid community that security in Kismayo could deteriorate, according to field radio reports monitored in the Somali capital.
Thieves stole around $4,300 in Somali shillings from the United Nations children's fund UNICEF office in Kismayo, according to UNICEF, Mogadishu.
Somalia has been without a central government since the overthrow in 1991 of Mohamed Siad Barre.
